territorial_scope.description: Applies in New Jersey to controllers that conduct business in the State or target residents, and that meet consumer-count thresholds.

evidence.quote: shall only apply to controllers that conduct business in the State or produce products or services that are targeted to residents of the State

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: New Jersey statute giving consumers rights over their personal data and imposing duties on controllers and processors, enforced by the Attorney General, effective on the 365th day after enactment.
summary.long: P.L.2023, c.266 applies to controllers doing business in New Jersey or targeting its residents that control or process personal data of at least 100,000 consumers a year, or 25,000 consumers while selling personal data for revenue or a price discount. It gives consumers rights to access, correct, delete and obtain copies of their personal data and to opt out of targeted advertising, sale and certain profiling. Controllers must provide a privacy notice, limit collection and purposes, obtain consent for sensitive data and for targeted advertising or profiling of consumers aged 13 to 17, answer verified requests within 45 days with an appeal process, and document data protection assessments for heightened-risk processing. Controllers must honour a user-selected universal opt-out mechanism from six months after the effective date. Exemptions cover protected health information, certain financial institutions, consumer reporting agencies and state agencies. The Attorney General has sole enforcement authority, with a 30-day cure notice before enforcement until the 18th month after the effective date, and no private right of action. The act takes effect on the 365th day after enactment.

notes: Bill number S332 appears only in registry metadata; the text cites P.L.2023, c.266. Internal inconsistencies: s.14(b) refers to 'the operator controller', and 'operator' is not defined in the Act. S.4(e) refers to rights 'afforded under section 5 of P.L.2023, c.266 (C.56:8-166.8)', but section 5 is the anti-discrimination provision; consumer rights are in section 7 (C.56:8-166.10). Section 17 sets effect on the 365th day after enactment (approved January 16, 2024); no calendar date is computed here. Relations are cross-references; target_instrument_id is empty where the target is not in the registry.

thresholds.variable_text: consumers whose personal data the controller controls or processes
thresholds.measurement: During a calendar year; excludes personal data processed solely for the purpose of completing a payment transaction
thresholds.consequence: The Act's provisions apply to the controller.
thresholds.conditions: Controller conducts business in the State or produces products or services targeted to residents of the State; alternative to the 25,000-consumer limb with revenue or discount from sale of personal data.

evidence.quote: control or process the personal data of at least 100,000 consumers, excluding personal data processed solely for the purpose of completing a payment transaction

thresholds.variable_text: consumers whose personal data the controller controls or processes, combined with revenue or discount from sale of personal data
thresholds.measurement: During a calendar year; combined with the controller deriving revenue, or receiving a discount on the price of goods or services, from the sale of personal data
thresholds.consequence: The Act's provisions apply to the controller.
thresholds.conditions: Controller conducts business in the State or produces products or services targeted to residents of the State; controller derives revenue, or receives a discount on the price of any goods or services, from the sale of personal data.

evidence.quote: control or process the personal data of at least 25,000 consumers

thresholds.variable_text: consumer's age (at least 13 but younger than 17 years)
thresholds.value_text: at least 13 years of age but younger than 17 years of age
thresholds.measurement: Based on the controller's actual knowledge, or willful disregard, of the consumer's age
thresholds.consequence: Controller may not process the consumer's personal data for targeted advertising, sale, or certain profiling without the consumer's consent.
thresholds.conditions: Controller has actual knowledge, or willfully disregards, that the consumer is in this age range.

evidence.quote: at least 13 years of age but younger than 17 years of age

thresholds.variable_text: radius of location precision defining precise geolocation data
thresholds.measurement: Location information directly identifying the specific location of an individual with precision and accuracy within the stated radius
thresholds.consequence: Data meeting this definition is precise geolocation data, which is within the definition of sensitive data; processing sensitive data requires consent.
thresholds.conditions: Information derived from technology that directly identifies the specific location of an individual; excludes content of communications and advanced utility metering data.

evidence.quote: within a radius of 1,750 feet

thresholds.variable_text: ownership or voting power over another entity (affiliate control)
thresholds.value_text: more than 50 percent of the outstanding shares of any class of voting security of a company
thresholds.measurement: Share of outstanding shares of any class of voting security, or control over election of a majority of directors or similar individuals
thresholds.consequence: Entities meeting this control test are affiliates; disclosures to an affiliate are excluded from the definition of sale.
thresholds.conditions: Alternatively, control over election of a majority of directors or individuals exercising similar functions, or a controlling influence over management or policies.
